title: Northstar Cloud Inc. Form 8-K earnings release
bodyText:
UNITED STATES
FORM 8-K
Item 2.02 Results of Operations and Financial Condition.
On May 3, 2026, Northstar Cloud Inc. issued an earnings release announcing financial results for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. Revenue was $184.2 million, compared with $151.0 million in the prior-year period. Net income was $12.4 million and diluted EPS was $0.18. A copy of the earnings release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1.
